en: Colorized landscape view over a hilly town with many villas and houses with red roofs surrounded by green trees and vineyards. On the hill to the left stands a light-colored building complex labeled 'Friedensburg.' In the middle distance and on the ridgeline are scattered buildings and a small tower-like structure. The title text at the top center names the locale as 'Niederlößnitz–Kötzschenbroda.' The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century German picture postcard.
